tasks.label: CMake: Configure (VSCode)
tasks.command: $buildDir = if ($IsWindows) { "build_win_dx11" } else { "build_vscode" }; if (!(Test-Path $buildDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $buildDir | Out-Null }; if ($IsWindows) { cmake -S . -B $buildDir -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A x64 } elseif (Get-Command ninja -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { cmake -S . -B $buildDir -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug } else { cmake -S . -B $buildDir -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug }

tasks.label: CMake: Build (VSCode)
tasks.command: $buildDir = if ($IsWindows) { "build_win_dx11" } else { "build_vscode" }; if (!(Test-Path $buildDir)) { throw "$buildDir does not exist. Run CMake: Configure first." }; if (Test-Path "$buildDir\build.ninja") { cmake --build $buildDir } else { cmake --build $buildDir --config Debug }

tasks.label: Run: metaphysics (VSCode)
tasks.command: $env:METAPHYSICS_RENDERER = "dx11"; $env:METAPHYSICS_UI = "imgui"; $buildDir = if ($IsWindows) { "build_win_dx11" } else { "build_vscode" }; $candidates = @("$buildDir\bin\Debug\metaphysics.exe","$buildDir\bin\Release\metaphysics.exe","$buildDir\bin\metaphysics.exe"); $exe = $candidates | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $exe) { throw "metaphysics.exe not found. Run CMake: Build first." }; $exeDir = Split-Path $exe -Parent; Push-Location $exeDir; try { .\metaphysics.exe } finally { Pop-Location }
